Hi, I’m Rey Joseph “RJ” Nieto.

I am a mathematician, university instructor, and communications professional.
I hold a First Class Honours BSc in Mathematics from the
[University of Bristol](https://www.bristol.ac.uk/) in England and currently teach
mathematics and information technology at
[Bulacan State University](https://bulsu.edu.ph/) (BulSU) in the Philippines. Before returning
to formal study, I worked across journalism, broadcasting, public affairs,
technical writing, and government communications.
:::

This website brings together the different strands of my academic and
professional work.

- The [**TDA**](computational-topology/index.qmd) section
contains self-study notes adapted and expanded from my bachelor’s thesis on
the computational stability of cubical homology in retinal imaging.

- The
[**Teaching**](teaching/index.qmd) section contains materials for
*Mathematics in the Modern World*, which I teach at BulSU.

- The
[**CV**](cv/index.qmd) section provides a fuller account of my academic and
professional background.
